item.summary: An Israeli strike on central Beirut – which came without warning – has left at least 12 dead and 41 injured. Meanwhile shrapnel from an Iranian missile launch killed two people in a Tel Aviv suburb, hours after Iran confirmed its security chief had been killed in an air strike...

item.title: Iran using cluster munitions in retaliatory strikes on Israel
item.summary: Iran is continuing its retaliatory strikes against Israel, with some damage to homes in central Israel this Tuesday. Israel says Tehran is using cluster munitions, which explode mid-air and indiscriminately scatter bomblets across a wide area. FRANCE 24's Carys Garland reports.

item.title: Senegal stripped of AFCON title as Morocco's appeal upheld by CAF
item.summary: Morocco were stunningly awarded the Africa Cup of Nations title on Monday by the CAF Appeal Board. Morocco saw their appeal upheld more than two months after they lost the chaotic final to Senegal, during which several Senegalese players controversially walked off the pitch.
